headline.caveat: $15B immediate + $35B contingent on the earlier of an OpenAI IPO or specified milestones; largest single check in OpenAI's $122B round

nature_md: Amazon anchored OpenAI's early-2026 mega-round (closed Mar 31, 2026 at $852B post-money) with $50B: $15B funded immediately, and $35B committed upon the earlier of (1) an OpenAI IPO or (2) OpenAI meeting 'specified milestones' (Reuters reported these related to declaring AGI). Amazon funded the remaining $35B on July 31, 2026 — coverage conflicts on whether milestones were formally met or Amazon simply exercised early; Amazon did not say. Press reports put the resulting stake at ~5% (unconfirmed). The equity came paired with a $100B/8-year expansion of OpenAI's AWS compute contract (see related edge) — investor and vendor in the same handshake.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Non-marketable equity investment on Amazon's balance sheet, carried at fair value with remeasurement gains/losses in non-operating income (the same treatment producing Amazon's headline Anthropic marks). No income-statement expense for the purchase itself.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Equity financing — no revenue or liability. Proceeds substantially fund compute purchases, including from AWS itself under the expanded $38B+$100B contracts, which AWS recognizes as revenue: the round-trip concern.

both_sides_md: **Bear:** Amazon paid $50B into a customer that simultaneously committed $138B to AWS — investor cash cycling back as cloud revenue at cycle-defining scale, and the $35B 'milestone' gate was waived in practice, suggesting the gate was decorative. **Bull:** OpenAI is the single largest source of incremental cloud demand in the world; a ~5% stake plus anchor-tenant economics ahead of a $1T+ IPO is a rational use of Amazon's balance sheet, and the funding was majority third-party (SoftBank, NVIDIA, others) rather than Amazon-only.

events.title: Amazon funds final $35B tranche, completing the $50B investment
events.why_it_matters: Committed became realized ahead of schedule — and ahead of the IPO/milestone triggers as publicly understood.
